description_en: Creates a room. Users can use features such as live streaming, whiteboard, and audio and video communication in the room
description_zh: 调用CreateRoom创建一个房间，用户可以在房间内使用直播、白板、音视频通信等功能
kebab_example: aliyun imp create-room --app-id 7m000q --title RoomTitle001 --room-owner-id as0000hs --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRoom

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the application. The value can contain lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 应用唯一标识，可以包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The template ID. Valid values:

default: the default template.

If you leave this parameter empty, the value default is used
parameters.help_zh:
模板ID。取值：

default：默认。

传空值，则默认为default
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The room ID. Maximum length: 36 characters. If you leave this parameter empty, a room ID is randomly generated
parameters.help_zh: 房间ID，最大长度36个字符，传空值，则随机生成一个房间ID
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.help_en: The room title. Chinese characters, English characters, and digits are supported. Maximum length: 32 characters
parameters.help_zh: 房间标题，支持中英文和数字，最大长度32个字符
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en: The room notice. Chinese characters, English characters, digits, and common symbols are supported. Maximum length: 256 characters
parameters.help_zh: 房间公告，支持中英文和数字以及常用符号，最大长度256个字符
parameters.name: notice

parameters.help_en: The ID of the room owner. Only English characters and digits are supported. Maximum length: 36 characters
parameters.help_zh: 房主ID，仅支持英文和数字，最大长度36个字符
parameters.name: room_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The extension field. Pass this parameter as needed to record additional room properties. The total length of all field key-value pairs cannot exceed 2048 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 拓展字段，按需传递，需要额外记录的房间属性。所有字段键-值长度总和不超过2048字节
parameters.name: extension

Result.description_en: The result of creating the room
Result.title_en: API请求的返回结果结构体。
Result.title_zh: API请求的返回结果结构体。
